messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — Cascade tenant cutover planned for 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. Need safety-gate approval and final release notes link. Model runtime pinned to v2.3.1 for this tenant, fallback set to v2.3.0.
Deploybot: Scheduled cutover job created: `cutover:cascade-tenant:2026-03-23T02:00Z`. Canary slice = 5% traffic for 15m, metric gates: p50 < 120ms, error-rate < 0.5%. Rollback threshold: sustained error-rate > 1% for 5m.
Kevin: ack on schedule. Confirming we have dedicated capacity reserved for 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Maria: Yes reserved. Also note KMS rotation window currently set for 03:00 UTC — that collides. Elaine, did security sign off on moving KMS?
Elaine: I can move KMS rotation to 04:30 UTC, security ok. Will update ops calendar.
Jamal: Quick note — release notes draft is at https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/cascade-2-3-1 (please review). Key items: model pinning, kvcache migration, new quant profile.
Maria: Thanks Jamal. Two asks before I trigger: (1) product ops confirm no billing or rate-limit changes for tenant, (2) SRE check alerting runbooks updated for new quant profile.
ProductOps (kevin): Confirmed, no billing or rate-limit changes.
SRE-oncall: Runbooks updated (link: https://runbooks/redwood/cascade-cutover). Added a step to verify KV cache warm-up and prefix caching behavior.
Kevin: small test — can we run the `cutover dry-run --slice=canary` tomorrow 18:00 UTC? want to exercise hooks.
Maria: good call. I've scheduled dry-run for 18:00 UTC and notified infra. Deploybot will post status.
Deploybot: Dry-run job queued: `dryrun:cascade:2026-03-22T18:00Z`. Results will post to thread.
Elaine: Approving safety gate from security side. :white_check_mark:
Jamal: Product ok from my side, release notes finalised. :thumbsup:
Kevin: SRE ack. I'll be on-call during cutover.
Maria: All approvals received — I'm greenlighting the cutover. I'll trigger final staging smoke 30m prior and then flip canary at 02:00 UTC. If we hit rollback thresholds, we'll fallback to v2.3.0 and open postmortem.
SRE-oncall: Copy. I'll monitor latency traces and error spikes; ops alerting will page at 0.8% error sustained 3m.
Maria: Thanks team. Anything else?
Kevin: none from infra.
Elaine: Nothing else.
Maria: Ok closing thread for now — Deploybot will post updates. If anything changes ping me directly.
